reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p6 gives AC 3, 16 HD, 24-inch movement, 8–32 damage, magic-weapon-only vulnerability, carrying/strength escape and surprise details. PHB spell card summarizes summoning/use and control conditions, but no MM stat profile is copied; MM link is present in sourceRecord and route is in snapshot.
limitations: Specific citation-chip click/page selection was not tested.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: Pixels show Imp at p54, Pseudo-dragon continuing p79–80, and Quasit at p80. The card’s selected special-familiar benefits align with the visible telepathy/senses, distance, close-range magic resistance/regeneration, level consequences and weekly six-question lower-plane contact. The card explicitly directs users to MM for other creature abilities; full imp/pseudo-dragon/quasit profiles are not reproduced.
limitations: The table of possible familiars and alignment mapping originate in PHB p66, not MM; they are outside this MM source assertion.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p10–11 is the Blink Dog profile and its innate teleporting attack procedure, not the PHB Blink spell procedure. The spell card’s 2-foot displacement/2d4 timing remains PHB-derived; the sourceRecord contains an MM Blink Dog reference.
limitations: No evidence establishes the purpose/relevance of this MM cross-reference; do not treat it as proof of PHB Blink coverage.

reviewedFacts.siteStatus: present-for-16-HD-spell-method-row; MM general control procedure is separately cited and its relationship to PHB spell-specific control is unresolved
reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p37 has a three-row hit-dice table: spell 16 HD, summoning device 12 HD, staff 8 HD. The owner Area field “typically 16 HD” exactly matches the spell row. MM pp37–38 also state a general control process: failure to concentrate turns the elemental on the summoner 75% of the time, otherwise it returns immediately; control cannot be regained, and a lost elemental returns after three turns; concentration requires stationary focus without physical/mental interruption and only one elemental may be controlled. PHB card separately contains its spell-specific 5% rebellion chance from round two onward. No ruling that these are equivalent or contradictory is made.
limitations: Device/staff rows are not omissions from a spell-only Area field.
PHB-specific and MM-general control procedures must remain separate pending source/rules interpretation.
Actual source-chip click/page selection remains untested.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p28–29 contains Djinni stats and creature powers, including its own material-creation power. The Minor Creation card states the PHB illusionist spell’s vegetable-material creation and its volume/duration, but does not claim those as Djinni data.
limitations: No evidence establishes whether this MM reference is intended as analogy or source support; do not treat it as proof of spell completeness.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p86 shows the Shadow stat block and prose, including strength drain and immunities. The spell card explicitly says monster statistics require MM and does not supply a shadow stat block; the sourceRecord links the page.
limitations: The source-linked viewer target was not clicked.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: MM p99 shows Giant Wasp stats (4 HD; two attacks 2–8 and 1–4; poison sting) and the qualifying nest/larval/flight prose. The UA card says insect effects use the giant form’s physical characteristics, with damage reduction and exclusions, and cites the Giant Wasp example; it does not reproduce the wasp profile.
limitations: The owner card’s table/examples are UA-derived; only the MM example/profile was checked.

reviewedFacts.sourceFinding: The MM p96 Treant entry explicitly gives small/medium/large height bands and corresponding two-attack damage (2–16, 3–18, 4–24); the UA field “Treant size and attacks” matches these bands and values. The MM reference object and fieldSources object both point to printed p96.
limitations: Other MM treant rules (7–8/9–10/11–12 HD, fire modifiers, tree animation/structural damage and lair behavior) are outside the named size-and-attacks field and are not asserted as fully represented by it.
Source-chip click and field evidence selection remain untested.
